title: Record one full-support n=8 parity prefix at 23/16 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

For the `n = 8` symbol `(1, 1/8, 1/16, 1/16, 1/16, 1/16, 1/16, 1/16)`, every proper prefix has infinity norm at most `3/2`. The largest proper prefix is `23/16`. The right shear alone is `2521/2048`, the next four proper prefixes are `5/4`, and the next five are `21/16`. The completed product has infinity norm `3/2`. This is the full-support step left open by #4802. The branch is from fetched main `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43` and does not replay that open package.

The tail `l1` is `1/2`. The schedule applies the right shear, then the even child, then the Schur child, then the left shear, and repeats that order inside every child. There are 22 factors and 21 proper prefixes. The quotient is `(1/8, 7/128, 105/2048, 1575/32768)`. The first prefix's bottom row sums to `1 + 1/8 + 7/128 + 105/2048 = 2521/2048`. The even child's right shear, with entry `1/16`, lifts the next four proper prefixes to `5/4`. The even grandchild's left shear, with entry `1/16`, lifts the next five to `21/16`. The even child's left shear then lifts the running product to `23/16`, and the remaining 10 proper prefixes stay there. The final left shear is not a proper prefix. The product of the 22 factors equals the even/odd reordering of the Toeplitz matrix, whose infinity norm is `3/2`.

`2521/2048 < 5/4 < 21/16 < 23/16 < 3/2 < 9/4`. This is the first symbol in this chain whose largest proper prefix is strictly below the one-level cap. The even child is `(1, 1/16, 1/16, 1/16)`. The Schur child is `(1, 3/64, 49/1024, 735/16384)`. Nine nontrivial factors sit in the proper prefixes.

This is one symbol. It does not bound every tail of `l1` at most `1/2`, the generator-shear compiler, the completed Gaussian stage, or the dyadic `p^100` normalizer. No new κ. The selected record is `60403/20000000`.

## Test plan

- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/triangular-parity-seven-entry`
- [x] Prints `PASS_TRIANGULAR_PARITY_SEVEN_ENTRY` and `outcome=completed`
- [ ] Maintainer replay was not run

Base `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`, priority revision 7. Upstream fetches at 2026-10-22T20:23:24Z and the pre-submit fetch at 2026-10-22T20:25:49Z were that commit. The pinned blobs of `certificates/selected-result.json` (`c35482cd9035843b15a634cc8276a7e1e40e8395`), `GAUSSIAN.md` (`adfb28c93e6b06178c901caaac39ede41a9e541b`), and `vendor/SHALLOW-TOEPLITZ.md` (`bc4349b2daea548ffa09e1f38a31f1df86b0b7be`) were unchanged. κ remains `60403/20000000`.

Prepared by James Reed with substantial Cursor Grok 4.7 assistance.
